notes.title: v0.7.0.2 - Stamps
notes.content:
We've got a few bug fixes for you, but the highlight of this release is Stamps.  In addition to selecting materials for your blocks, you can now stamp your blocks with a whole lot of different styles.  You'll find the new Stamps section in the Construction menu when you hit the Tab key.  Enjoy!  And as always, we look forward to seeing your feedback on the discussion forums!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Stamps
  [*]Added an option in video settings to toggle fullscreen/windowed mode
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Fixed crashing when changing resolutions!
  [*]Fixed only showing a black screen on some Macs using external monitors (by allowing windowed mode)
[/list]
